description:
Upload large amounts of street-level imagery directly from the comfort of your desktop.


- Added “Mark video start point” to align GPX tracks with video
- Clearer warning and error displays: banners under Images and Videos list each file that won’t be uploaded or has a warning, and why
- Updated to the latest mapillary_tools (0.15.0) and ExifTool (13.60) to support more cameras
- Files you already uploaded are now marked as duplicates in the sidebar and on the map before you upload (“Upload all (with duplicates)” uploads them again)
- GPX files are checked when you add them: unreadable or empty files, files without timestamps and tracks that don’t cover the video get a clear message, and a track much longer or shorter than the video gets a warning
- The start and end of a video’s GPX track are shown on the map while editing
- Unsupported files and images taken too close together are no longer skipped silently: Upload complete shows e.g. “Uploaded 18 / 20 files” and lists duplicates, warnings, skipped files and errors
- Click anywhere in the drop area, or drop files on the Upload complete screen, to start a new upload
- Fixed bug where files could not be processed on Apple Silicon Macs (“Unknown System Error - 86”)
- Fixed bug where the Linux AppImage did not open on systems without libfuse2, such as Ubuntu 24.04
- Fixed bug where upload progress could go above the total size after a retry or a dropped connection
- Fixed bug where mapillary_tools kept running in the background after processing was stopped or the app was closed
- Security updates
